_meta._note: Chapter 36, Lesson 10 (ch36-test, new — not ch36-l07). Rebuilt 2026-10-03 in the proposal harvest, batch 3 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-36-content-proposal.md and its review amendments. Twelve multiple-choice questions on six two-question strands: maṣdar versus verb and a taught Form I pair (q01–02), Form II/IV pairs (q03–04), exact Quran excerpts (q05–06), active participle (q07–08), passive participle (q09–10) and the three-way distinction (q11–12). Pass mark 80 %: 9/12 fails, 10/12 passes. Answer positions are 3/3/3/3 with no repeating cycle. Optional Arabic is left off the meaning options where it would let a learner match text instead of understand it. Removed: the Form II 'تَفْعَالٌ / تَكْتَابٌ' rule, إِقْرَارٌ and آمَنَ filed under the wrong form, 'the Quran begins with 87:1', تَسْبِيحٌ placed inside 87:1/87:2, the unsupported 'every page / hundreds' claims, the الصَّلَاة maṣdar classification, the 'Peak 1 mastery' label, malformed build sentences and the stray Chinese/Cyrillic text.
